text: 从得零售者得天下到竞速产业金融新赛道：银行业这一次战略转移并非“垒大户” 越来越多的银行正在转向“拼专业、拼产业认知”的高质量发展路径。
text_en: From 'he who wins retail wins the world' to racing on the new track of industrial finance: this strategic shift by the banking industry is not about 'building large clients.' More and more banks are turning to a high-quality development path of 'competing on professionalism and industrial insight.'
